facebookresearch_access/access/feature_e.get_lexical_complexity_score: compute the lexical complexity score of a sentence using fasttext word ranks and the 75th percentile
facebookresearch_access/access/feature_e.get_levenshtein_similarity: calculate the Levenshtein similarity ratio between a complex sentence and a simple sentence
facebookresearch_access/access/feature_e.get_dependency_tree_depth: compute the maximum dependency tree depth of a sentence using spaCy parsing
facebookresearch_access/access/feature_e.get_rank: get the fasttext vocabulary rank of a word from the preloaded word-to-rank mapping
facebookresearch_access/access/feature_e.get_log_rank: get the natural log of one plus the fasttext vocabulary rank of a word

facebookresearch_access/access/preproces.replace_lrb_rrb: replace bracket tokens like -lrb- and -rrb- with actual parentheses in text
facebookresearch_access/access/preproces.add_noise: add noise to a sentence by shuffling, dropping, and blanking words randomly
facebookresearch_access/access/preproces.normalize_quotes: normalize backticks and double single quotes to standard quotes in text
facebookresearch_access/access/preproces.split_file: split a file into multiple output files using round robin line distribution
facebookresearch_access/access/preproces.merge_files: merge multiple input files into one output file in round robin or sequential order

facebookresearch_access/access/preproces.create_composed_preprocessor: create a ComposedPreprocessor to chain multiple preprocessors and encode sentences sequentially
facebookresearch_access/access/preproces.encode_sentences_with_sentencepiece: encode sentences into subword pieces using the SentencePiecePreprocessor with a custom vocab size
facebookresearch_access/access/preproces.extract_special_tokens: extract and remove angle bracket special tokens from the beginning of a sentence
facebookresearch_access/access/preproces.add_levenshtein_feature: add a LevenshteinPreprocessor to prepend a target edit distance ratio token to sentences
facebookresearch_access/access/preproces.dump_and_load_preprocessors: dump preprocessors to a pickle file and load them back from a directory path

facebookresearch_access/access/simplifie.create_fairseq_simplifier: create a fairseq simplifier from an experiment directory to simplify complex source files
facebookresearch_access/access/simplifie.create_preprocessed_simplifier: create a preprocessed simplifier that encodes input files before simplification and decodes output
facebookresearch_access/access/simplifie.memoize_simplifier: memoize a simplifier function to cache predictions by file hash and reuse previous results
facebookresearch_access/access/simplifie.run_fairseq_simplifier: run the fairseq simplifier on a complex source file and write simplified predictions to an output file
facebookresearch_access/access/simplifie.run_preprocessed_simplifier: run a preprocessed simplifier pipeline that encodes, simplifies, and decodes source files

facebookresearch_access/access/text.py.word_tokenize: tokenize a sentence into words using NIST tokenizer and fix special entity tokens
facebookresearch_access/access/text.py.remove_punctuation_tokens: remove all punctuation-only tokens from a text string and return cleaned text
facebookresearch_access/access/text.py.remove_stopwords: remove English stopwords from a text string and return the remaining words
facebookresearch_access/access/text.py.spacy_process: process text with spaCy NLP model and return an annotated Doc object
facebookresearch_access/access/text.py.is_punctuation: check if a single word consists entirely of punctuation characters
